name: ISIS Neutron and Muon Source — Rutherford Appleton Laboratory campus and target-station buildings
notes: No accelerator, beamline or target-station record exists for ISIS in the atlas; the R55 and R80 buildings are therefore context features attached to site:isis-rutherford-appleton by site_id, not by entity_id.

summary.plain: The Rutherford Appleton Laboratory campus in Oxfordshire, drawn to scale with the two buildings that house ISIS Target Station 1 and Target Station 2. The 163-metre proton synchrotron and the KARMEN neutrino detector site could not be placed from public sources.
summary.technical: One local map for facility:isis-neutron-source. Drawn from OpenStreetMap: the RAL campus polygon (way 69870055), building R55 (Target Station 1 experimental hall, building:part way 1454005510) and building R80 (Target Station 2, way 750266080); the R55/R80 identification is ISIS's own safety page. The synchrotron (163 m, IPAC 2014) and detector:karmen (17.7 m from the target, 100 degrees to the beam) are listed as unlocated.

unlocated.backlog: Find a published ISIS site plan or synchrotron hall drawing (an ISIS or STFC design report, or an STFC estates GIS layer with a licence) that places the ring on the RAL site, and georeference it against at least three OSM building corners; then add a length check against 163 m. A circle may be drawn only if a source states the ring's radius and centre.
unlocated.reason: ISIS proton synchrotron (163 m circumference, 800 MeV, 50 Hz rapid-cycling, per IPAC 2014). OpenStreetMap maps no ring, tunnel or synchrotron hall at RAL, and no fetched source gives the ring's centre or its building; the R55 and R80 outlines are the target-station buildings named by ISIS's safety page, and no source places the synchrotron relative to them. The Atlas has no accelerator record for the synchrotron.

unlocated.backlog: Needs the surveyed positions of the ISIS target and proton beam axis in site coordinates (an ISIS/RAL civil drawing or a KARMEN technical paper with a site plan), then the sourced 17.7 m / 100 degree offset places the detector. Until then the KARMEN bunker cannot be located.
unlocated.reason: KARMEN sat 17.7 m from the ISIS target at 100 degrees to the proton beam (KARMEN detector description). The ISIS target and beam direction have no sourced coordinates, the site point is campus-grade (1500 m), and the KARMEN bunker was a 1990-2001 installation that no fetched source or OSM element places; a position derived from the campus point would be invented geometry.
